parties: Tube Investments of India Limited (acquirer) & CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited (target)
headline: Tube Investments of India Limited Submits SEBI Takeover Disclosure for CG Power
sum: Tube Investments of India has filed a SEBI Regulation 31(4)/(5) disclosure relating to a substantial acquisition or open offer for CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited. Specific terms, consideration and deal structure not yet publicly confirmed in available sources.
implication: The disclosure triggers mandatory SEBI takeover regime compliance; pending confirmation of whether this is a hostile/friendly acquisition, the offer price, and any conditions precedent that may gate regulatory approval.
detail: This NSE filing evidences a formal takeover-regime disclosure by Tube Investments under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011. Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) typically require disclosure of the acquisition of shares, open offer details, and key commercial terms. Further substantive terms (bid price, number of shares, conditions, approvals timeline) are not available in public sources at this time.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Reg. 31(4)–(5)
framework.note: Central: Mandates disclosure of substantial share acquisitions and takeover offer details to stock exchange and regulator.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Reg. 4–12
framework.note: Defines thresholds for substantial acquisition (25% of voting capital or control) and triggers for open offer.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Schedule A & B (Form A & Form B)
framework.note: Central: Prescribes the structure and content of the offer document for open offers.
May apply if the acquisition is structured as a scheme of arrangement requiring shareholder/court approval.
Mandates approval from stock exchange and compliance with listing conditions during acquisition process.
Applies if Tube Investments has foreign shareholding; overseas remittance of consideration requires RBI approval.
May require CCI approval if combined turnover or asset thresholds are breached.
Relevant only if CG Power is in financial distress or formal insolvency proceedings.

approvals: SEBI approval / acceptance of disclosure under Regulation 31

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Reg. 31(4)–(5)
triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure filing with exchange upon announcement or commencement of acquisition or offer process.
Exchange approval required before open offer documentation is released to shareholders.
